items.question_text: The hour does not make a routine request urgent. Bill appropriately, or not at all. The rest of the history does not create an exception. Convenience, a rural setting, or a patient's agreement does not create an item or a safe service. Apply the billing, access, or transfer rule as it stands. Do not bill or proceed on a workaround. State the correct step clearly. Nothing in the consultation creates a billing exception or a safe workaround. The rule is the same in a busy clinic or a rural hospital. Apply it to the facts in front of you. Do not invent an item, an authority, or a clearance the system does not provide. That is the correct step. Decide on the rule, not on what would be easier to claim or to arrange tonight. Document what you do. Clearly. Today. A patient's agreement, a full list, or a missing nurse does not create the missing authority. Bill only what was done, access only what you may, and transfer when the local service cannot cope.
